parsed.summary: Tracing the drawing against the specification, every functional element matches: the SS54 series diode on the external-5V jack, the PMEG3030EP (3A/360mV) into the servo rail with four 100 µF caps, the 0.1 µF decoupling on the MAX3485 VCC, the IRLML6402 high-side battery switch with its 47 k gate resistor and SPDT, the BC857 auto-direction transistor fed by the 10 k/5.1 k divider from TXD2, the 2 k/20 k/2.2 k/2.2 k fail-safe/bias set on the A/B and DE/RE lines, the 1 k series resistors to the servo signal pins, and the 0 Ω PWM-select and serial-bridge jumpers (with the 'Short R13,R14 for Serial Servo' and 'Short R10,R10 / Short R9,R11' annotations). The reference designators are systematically re-numbered relative to the spec's table (e.g. the PNP is labelled Q1 and the P-FET Q2, the SS54 is D3 and the PMEG3030EP D1, the 4-pin PortB header is J1), but that is a naming difference of this particular build, not a deviation in topology, part type, value, polarity or connectivity; no net is shorted to a supply or to GND, no signal pin is mis-tied, and no passive's own type/value/role is inconsistent. I therefore judge the schematic to be a correct build of the intended design.
